background: Credit Agricole CIB is the corporate and investment bank of the Credit Agricole group, funded in wholesale markets and by corporate deposits, active in structured finance, capital markets and international trade and transaction banking.
synthesis: Ratings are strong at AA- from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A+ from S&P and Aa3 from Moody's, all stable, and rest on the cooperative group behind it. The entity's own ratios are thin against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 12.4%, leverage of 3.6%, LCR of 120% and NSFR of 112% are all in the bottom quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Jun 2026, and nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A deposit here is a call on group support, which the ratings judge strong.
